decisionsTitle: A line of the internal list has its name corrected in place
decisionsSection:
**Amends «Lista internă (doar notițe)»** (the internal list's decisions: its add, note and delete for the Organizer and above, its moves for the Administrator).

**The owner, of a name written wrong on the waiting list:** "de asemenea trebuie să pot edita numele persoanelor din lista de așteptare" — the person's name had been written with a wrong spelling.

**Decision.** Each line of the internal list carries a native fold «Corectează numele» with the first and last name as they stand and the button «Salvează numele». It is for exactly the roles that add, note and delete a line (the Organizer and above); the service asserts the role (`renameReserveEntry`) and the action asserts it again (BR-REQ-060-01), and every other role gets no fold. The name goes through the add's own parse, now one function (`parseReserveName`, shared by `parseReserveEntry`): trimmed, 1 to the add's maximum per box, the refusal naming the box. The add has no rule about a name already on the list, so the rename has none either. The line keeps its place, address, note, author and creation moment; a save of the same name writes nothing and says so quietly. A line moved or deleted meanwhile is NOT_FOUND. The trail has one new action, `event_reserve.renamed`: who, when and which line, never the old or the new name. A refusal comes back as the form's state with what was typed; a success returns to the same list (its filters, sort and page) with the panel open and a toast, nothing typed in the address or the flash. No migration, no email, nothing sent to the person.

**The fold is a box on its own line.** In the backoffice every fold is a box (the boxed fold object), so the fold is drawn on a full-width line of its own under the line's caption, above the note, never between the buttons: opened, its two boxes get the whole width at every screen size and the button row keeps only buttons.

**Two boxes, not one.** The line stores a first and a last name, so the fold has both boxes: a single box would have to guess where the first name ends in a name of several words.

**Refused.** Fixing the name by deleting and adding the line again (it loses its place, its note and who wrote it down); a copy of the add's parse; a confirmation dialog (a name on a notes list is neither irreversible nor sent anywhere); putting the old or the new name in the trail.
changelogLine: - **«Corectează numele» on the internal list** — each line has a fold with the first and last name and «Salvează numele», for the Organizer and above; the line keeps its place, note and address, and the trail records the fix without the name. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a line of «Lista internă (doar notițe)», when the Organizer or above saves «Corectează numele», then the name is parsed as the add parses it, the line keeps its place, note, address, author and creation moment, a save of the same name writes nothing, a line moved or deleted meanwhile is refused as not found, and the trail row `event_reserve.renamed` names who, when and which line but never a name; every other role is refused and writes nothing (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
